text_en: To the leader: according to Lilies. Of the Korahites. A Maskil. A love song.
text_cn: 科辣黑后裔的训诲歌，又名爱情歌。交与乐官，调寄"百合"。

text_en: My heart overflows with a goodly theme; I address my verses to the king; my tongue is like the pen of a ready scribe.
text_cn: 我的心灵涌溢优雅的言辞， 向我君王倾吐我的赞美诗； 我舌好像书写流利的妙笔。

text_en: You are the most handsome of men; grace is poured upon your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
text_cn: 你在世人中最为美丽， 你口唇中流露着慈惠， 因此天主永远祝福你。

text_en: Gird your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your glory and majesty.
text_cn: 英雄！请在腰间佩带你的刀剑， 就是佩带上你的荣耀和威严。

text_en: In your majesty ride on victoriously for the cause of truth and to defend the right; let your right hand teach you dread deeds.
text_cn: 愿你为了信实和正义驱驾顺利， 愿你的右手指导你惊人的奇事！

text_en: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; the peoples fall under you.
text_cn: 万民必因你的锐箭屈服于你， 君王的众仇敌必要胆破心悸。

text_en: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever. Your royal scepter is a scepter of equity;
text_cn: 上主！你的御座永远常存， 你治国的权杖无比公允。

text_en: you love righteousness and hate wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your companions;
text_cn: 你爱护正义，你又憎恨罪辜： 为这个原故，天主，你的天主， 以喜油傅你，胜过你的伴侣。

text_en: your robes are all fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia. From ivory palaces stringed instruments make you glad;
text_cn: 你的衣冠散布没药、沉香、与肉桂的芬芳。 由象牙宫中奏出弦乐的声音，使你欢畅；

text_en: daughters of kings are among your ladies of honor; at your right hand stands the queen in gold of Ophir.
text_cn: 列王的公主都成群结队前来欢迎你， 王后佩带敖非尔金饰，在你右边侍立。

text_en: Hear, O daughter, consider and incline your ear; forget your people and your father’s house,
text_cn: 女儿！请听，请看，也请侧耳细听： 忘却你的民族、和你父的家庭！

text_en: and the king will desire your beauty. Since he is your lord, bow to him;
text_cn: 因为君王恋慕你的美艳雅丽， 他是你主，你应向他伏首至地！

text_en: the people of Tyre will seek your favor with gifts, the richest of the people
text_cn: 提洛的女儿都前来奉献礼品， 民间的显要都想得你的欢心。

text_en: with all kinds of wealth. The princess is decked in her chamber with gold-woven robes;
text_cn: 公主穿戴齐备，姗姗来迎， 她的衣服全是金丝绣成。

text_en: in many-colored robes she is led to the king; behind her the virgins, her companions, follow.
text_cn: 她身穿绣衣华服，被引到君王面前， 成群的童女陪伴着她，也到你身边：

text_en: With joy and gladness they are led along as they enter the palace of the king.
text_cn: 在欢乐歌舞声中， 一齐进入了王宫。

text_en: In the place of ancestors you, O king, shall have sons; you will make them princes in all the earth.
text_cn: 你的子孙要承嗣你的先祖； 立他们为王，统治普天率土。

text_en: I will cause your name to be celebrated in all generations; therefore the peoples will praise you forever and ever.
text_cn: 我要使你的名永垂不朽； 万民将歌颂你至于永久。
